required_design_changes.change: Name/expose the result as normalized unverified input, or include an explicit immutable provenance/verification marker with equivalent semantics. Describe observed/clear/succeeded as reported field values rather than a trusted provider observation. Future durable financial use must require separately authenticated provider retrieval provenance plus original-source/final commit admission; re-proving original paid source alone does not prove a new refund/dispute. No current transport is requested.
required_design_changes.finding: FinancialObservation.capture takes an ordinary caller array. Matching account/payment/gross to a source-owned expectation proves internal referential consistency, not a provider GET, own-account credential scope, response authenticity, freshness or current financial state. A fabricated envelope can match these same identities.
required_design_changes.title: Normalize claimed data; do not authenticate provider observation

required_design_changes.change: Specify exact summary/state fields and supported statuses, USD source/provider currency relation, strictly integer positive original gross and bounded item amounts, overflow-safe sums, and unknown/incomplete/attention taxonomy. Keep succeeded sum and each non-succeeded status count/amount separate from the provider Charge aggregate; no pending/failed/canceled amount is settled by normalization. Define contradiction handling conservatively, including complete terminal lists versus pending/requires_action and separate-GET transitions; retain no atomic/settled-balance claim. Keep exact dispute statuses and observed disputed boolean/history separate without deriving active-access, lost-money or availability consequences. Never reconstruct Tax gross from pre_tax or double-count the repeated order gross per line.
required_design_changes.finding: The design leaves consistent refund aggregate and observation summary/status unspecified enough to accidentally copy the legacy release proof or treat pending items as settled. Existing normalizer explicitly preserves Charge.amount_refunded separately, while RefundResolution applies an intentionally stricter completed-refund policy for a different purpose.
required_design_changes.title: Pin monetary, status and output semantics

required_design_changes.change: Apply pure literal/defaultfalse purpose/pins/environment admission to both factories and normalizer; require raw standard maps/repository parents and supported standard literal env descriptor before offsets or resolver callbacks. Recheck the same new policy after the final source proof before issuing the value. Explicitly reject serialization/unserialization reconstruction of internal typed values; public projection is a bounded nonauthoritative summary only. Use lineCount and line1..count under before/after original source proofs with exact common order/payment/account/mode/provider/currency/gross/source identity fields and distinct producer versions. Add no source/frame/clock/receipt/commit authority, transaction begin/rollback/retry or new SQL/DML: existing source APIs remain in caller-owned original held frame and its original lifetime.
required_design_changes.finding: Only normalizer entry policy is explicitly gated, although factories invoke callback-capable original source proofs. A private readonly constructor alone does not block unserialize reconstruction. The shorthand no SQL boundary would be incorrect if interpreted literally, since proveRetainedCurrent performs existing authenticated reads/locks and marker proofs.
required_design_changes.title: Explicit source-factory policy and reconstruction boundaries

verified_existing_API_facts: Both final source classes expose lineCount(), line(position1-based) and proveRetainedCurrent(CurrentRows). Factories can iterate the actual complete1..10 lines under the same held source frame, without copied caller graph construction.

V1 line exposes amounts including USD original total; Tax V2 exposes separately typed tax.currency and tax.order_total_minor with buyer-reviewed provider calculated authority, plus separate pre_tax fields. They must stay distinct purposes.

Source lines identify account/funds mode/provider PaymentIntent but do not export an original Charge ID. Bind Charge IDs to the same supplied PaymentIntent.latest_charge within the observation envelope; do not claim comparison to an unavailable original Charge source field.

Existing ExecutionContextV1 binding fixes provider stripe/API2026-08-26.dahlia and retains explicit test/live plus provenance. The first-slice rehearsal normalizer must refuse live/unsupported mode without defaulting account/provider facts.

Legacy PaymentFinancialEvidence keeps provider amount_refunded separate from refund item statuses; RefundResolutionEvidence requires complete succeeded refunds/no disputes solely for test_refunded_exception_release of unfulfilled paid_exception resources. That stricter rule is not a general delivered-grant refund/access policy.

Installed Stripe21.3.2 Refund statuses are pending/requires_action/succeeded/failed/canceled; Dispute statuses include warning_needs_response/warning_under_review/warning_closed/needs_response/under_review/won/lost/prevented. Unsupported/null states remain attention/unknown.
